verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help docs confirm that users can post manual journal entries, both individually and in bulk via a CSV import template. Editing a posted entry automatically creates a reversing entry plus a new entry. Nothing in the evidence documents debit/credit balancing or memo fields. Missing for 10: documented enforcement of balanced debits and credits, documented supporting memo/description fields on entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: Need to post more than one manual journal entry at a time? Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
Puzzle automatically creates a voiding (reversing) journal entry for the original and posts a new entry reflecting your changes.
